description.value: Volta is a compact brunch spot in downtown Victoria with a Spanish-influenced edge, serving egg dishes with house-made brava sauce, pan con tomate, and chorizo alongside rich dark coffee. The kitchen turns out hearty hot sandwiches — cheesesteak, cubano, beef dip — as well as grab-and-go breakfast sandwiches and panini, making it a practical stop for a hungry cyclist passing through the Yates Street corridor. Everything is made in-house, from the potato hash to the jams and marinara.

Vegetarian substitutions (mushroom and leek for bacon/chorizo), a veggie cheesesteak, eggplant parmigiana, and a rotating vegetarian soup confirm vegetarian options.
